name: Superoxide dismutase [Cu-Zn]
blurb: Destroys toxic superoxide radicals; mutations cause inherited ALS.

misfolded.name: Misfolded SOD1 aggregates
misfolded.description: Mutant SOD1 loses its metal ions, unfolds and forms aggregates that can seed misfolding in neighbouring motor neurons.

function: Destroys radicals which are normally produced within the cells and which are toxic to biological systems. Catalyzes the oxidation of hydrogen sulfide (H2S) to sulfate, playing an important role in detoxifying H2S and limiting the accumulation of reactive sulfur species (RSS) such as persulfides and polysulfides

variants.note: Most common in North America; aggressive
Basis of the classic ALS mouse model
